Ceria burns webs away with it (1.54), and casts it in 1.58H. A burst around the caster and the teacher are design guesses.
Pisces kills a swarm of flies with [Frozen Wind] (1.22); Ceria also uses it (3.07H). A straight line and the teacher are design guesses.
Ceria learned [Fireball] at Level 18 as an [Elementalist] (1.47R) and casts it in 1.58H. A spellbook that teaches it is a design guess (spellbooks exist: 2.23, 3.07H); no shop sells it yet.
